deferred_follow_up: App Attest credential-id binding has real mutation evidence, but device-key extraction defense remains DEFERRED-FOLLOW-UP. The conformance test enters the production WebAuthn-shaped verifier with production mode enabled and proves that an attestation credential cannot be presented under a different key id; its Android arm also rejects a signed fixture carrying only a downgraded device-integrity verdict. This run does not prove Secure Enclave or StrongBox non-exportability, App Attest certificate and leaf-key binding under real Apple evidence, hardware-reference receipt signing, propagation of the verified device trust level into capabilities, or physical-device behavior. Follow-up work must remove raw signing seeds from the mobile receipt FFI, bind platform key references and attestation evidence into issued capabilities, and qualify real iOS and Android devices.
note: Real partial mutation evidence. The conformance test at crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/threats/device_key_extraction.rs presents a production-mode App Attest WebAuthn shape under the wrong key id and requires the typed KeyIdMismatch refusal before certificate processing. A targeted cargo-mutants run inverted the credential-id comparison at app_attest.rs:148; the typed rejection assertion caught the corrupted binding. PARTIAL: actual hardware non-exportability, real platform certificate evidence, hardware-reference receipt signing, Android trust projection, and device qualification remain deferred.
